title: Better Nether Sprouts
description: This project aims to fix the uneven-ness of the nether sprouts item texture.
body:
Have you ever been bothered by the Nether Sprouts item texture?

Well, this resource pack aims to fix the Nether Sprouts item texture. In vanilla Minecraft, the Nether Sprouts are directly in the center of the icon box and this resource pack lowers it so that the Nether Sprouts are 'growing' from the bottom of the item icon box.
